description: Career ladder generator — Builds an IC or manager career ladder for a role with 3-8 levels: title, summary, scope, typical years, observable expectations per competency and promotion signals. Offline checks flag scope that does not grow level to level, missing competency cells, near-duplicate adjacent levels and vague wording, with a quality score and a markdown table. Params: role, levels (default 5), track=ic|manager, competencies (comma list), company (context). Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_career_ladder
